}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "NanoPi M5" and "2411" are silkscreened on both sides of board.
{{See also|Rockchip|List of Single-board computers}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3576 Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A72) @2.2GHz :+ Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A53) @2.0GHz *GPU: ''Mali-G52 MC3'' (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.0, AFBC) :VPU: with 8K@30fps H.265, VP9, AV1 and AVS2 decoding :NPU: 6 TOPS @INT8 supports INT4, INT8, INT16, :FP16, BF16, TF32 mixed operation *Memory: 8GB (LPDDR5) SDRAM *Storage: 16MB (SPI NOR) Flash, :TF card (256GB)/MMC card slot, :UFS module socket *Network: 2x GbE ports *USB: 2x USB 3.1 ports *PCI: 1x PCIe 2.1 (x1) M.2 (M-Key), :1x M.2 SDIO (E-Key) slots *GPIO: 1x 30-pin headers *Power: 6-20V via USB (Type-C) PD port
